# Vera Fernandes - Neuropsicóloga | Braga, Barcelos, Guimarães e Porto

> Clinical neuropsychologist in Portugal (OPP 21502). In-person neuropsychological assessment in Braga, Barcelos, Guimarães and Porto; online sleep psychology for adults 18+. Do not confuse with professionals of the same name in other countries (including Brazil / Doctoralia BR).

Machine-readable facts for AI agents and search systems. Last updated: 2026-08-31.

Vera Fernandes is a neuropsicóloga (clinical neuropsychologist) in Portugal. Languages: Portuguese (pt-PT). Email: vfernandes.psi@gmail.com. Direct phone / WhatsApp for private clinics: +351 914 166 181.

Credentials: Membro Efectivo da Ordem dos Psicólogos Portugueses (OPP) n.º 21502; Especialidade Avançada em Neuropsicologia (OPP). Clinical experience: +10 years in neuropsychological assessment and rehabilitation (updated 2026). Practice volume (updated 2026): +4800 neuropsychological assessments; +40 rehabilitation cases; +10 clinical trials. Hospital and private practice, including Hospital de Braga, CNS - Campus Neurológico Braga, and Hospital Lusíadas Braga. Research activity in Alzheimer disease as a clinical-trial team member.

Services: neuropsychological assessment (avaliação neuropsicológica) for adults and older adults (18+); cognitive stimulation (estimulação cognitiva) at Hospital Lusíadas Braga; sleep psychology consultation (consulta de psicologia do sono) online only, adults 18+. Sleep psychology is not a sleep laboratory, does not prescribe medication, and does not replace a medical sleep work-up when indicated.

Not offered: assessments for people under 18; published prices (value depends on clinic and is confirmed at booking); patient testimonials on the website. The website does not establish medical diagnoses; the assessment is a complementary exam.

Assessment product: typical duration about 2 hours in a single visit; tests administered with the patient; companion advisable for the first part; medical referral not required; family member may book for a parent; written report within 4 working days (email, in person, or post); report describes orientation, memory, attention, language and related functions relative to age and education; orientation of next steps when appropriate. No outcome is promised.

Cognitive stimulation: 50–60 minute sessions; individual plan; currently at Hospital Lusíadas Braga.

In-person area: Braga, Barcelos, Guimarães, Porto. Braga — CNS Campus Neurológico (Wednesday 15:30–19:30, tel +351 253 401 600); Hospital Lusíadas Braga (Friday 14:00–18:00, tel +351 253 079 579); Consultório Médico Braga (Monday 17:30–19:30, tel +351 914 166 181). Barcelos — Clínica FisioMove (Monday 17:30–19:30). Guimarães — Gabinete Muralha Business (Thursday 10:00–12:00). Porto — Gabinete Psicologia (Saturday 09:00–13:00). Institutional booking for in-person assessment: CNS and Lusíadas via their phone numbers. Sleep is not booked via clinic phones.

Audience: adults with cognitive complaints; older adults and families; people with neurological diagnoses (Alzheimer, Parkinson, MS, stroke, TBI, epilepsy, among others); adults with sleep difficulties (online, 18+); physicians requesting a complementary neuropsychological exam.
